nodes.label: TPH Strategy Rationale
nodes.rationale: TPH chosen over TPT/separate tables because Transaction is a shared base class with common properties, resulting in simpler queries (single table), good performance for the data volume, and automatic inheritance for DepenseFixe and TransactionVariable.

nodes.label: Rationale: DelegatingHandler Disabled for JWT
nodes.rationale: JwtAuthorizationHandler (DelegatingHandler) is disabled because ProtectedLocalStorage uses JS interop, which is not accessible in the HTTP handler context. The token is instead added per-request in each FrontService via GetClientAsync().

nodes.label: Rationale: Prerendering Disabled
nodes.rationale: InteractiveServerRenderMode(prerender: false) set in App.razor because ProtectedLocalStorage requires JS interop, which is unavailable during static rendering phase.

nodes.label: Rationale: Proactive JWT Refresh Timer
nodes.rationale: Timer-based proactive refresh (3 min before expiry) chosen over refresh-on-API-call because inactive users could let token expire, and the timer runs server-side on the Blazor circuit without needing JS interop.

nodes.label: Rationale: AuthorizeView in MainLayout
nodes.rationale: AuthorizeView placed in MainLayout (not AuthorizeRouteView in Routes.razor, not [Authorize] per page) because it protects all pages using MainLayout uniformly, and AuthorizeRouteView caused infinite redirect loops when combined with MainLayout.

nodes.label: Rationale: Categories Are Global (Not Per-User)
nodes.rationale: Categories are shared across all users to avoid duplication. Generic categories (Food, Transport, etc.) are not user-specific and simplify management.

nodes.label: Rationale: HTTPS Disabled in App (Traefik Handles SSL)
nodes.rationale: UseHttpsRedirection and UseHsts removed because Traefik handles SSL termination. The app receives plain HTTP from Traefik; keeping these middlewares caused 404s on static files in Production.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: https disabled in app (traefik handles ssl)

nodes.label: Rationale: TPH NULL Handling in LINQ (== false not !)
nodes.rationale: In TPH columns nullable in SQL, !IsEchelonne in LINQ treats NULL as neither true nor false, accidentally excluding TransactionVariable rows. Using == false generates WHERE IsEchelonne = 0 which correctly handles NULLs.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: tph null handling in linq (== false not !)

nodes.label: Rationale: Clean Architecture with 4 Projects
nodes.rationale: 4-project structure (Entities, Application, Shared, Frontend) chosen for clear separation of concerns, component reusability, testability (layer isolation), and Clean Architecture pattern.

nodes.label: Table-Per-Hierarchy (TPH) Strategy
nodes.rationale: Transaction base class mapped TPH with discriminator 'TransactionTable' (Fixe/Variable). Comments warn against calling .ToTable on subtypes which would revert to TPT. Subtype-specific columns (IsEchelonne etc.) are nullable in SQL.

nodes.label: User Data Isolation by UserId
nodes.rationale: UserId FK added to Transactions with defaultValue 1 so pre-existing rows attach to a default user; cascade delete on user removal. Services filter all queries by userId.

nodes.label: Echelonnement (Installment Payments)
nodes.rationale: AddEtalonnage migration adds IsEchelonne/NombreEcheances/MontantParEcheance/EcheancesRestantes (all nullable, IsEchelonne default false) to support staggered installment generation of TransactionVariable from a DepenseFixe.
